source.title: Umbral Plume, WoWDB current item tooltip

quote: transform it into a Radiant Plume. (5 min cooldown)
notes: T0024; confirmed deterministic on-use transformation of a Midnight epic trinket from the critical-strike variant to the mastery variant, cross-checked https://wow4noobs.com/en/items/260235 and https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Umbral_Plume_(trinket). Each action transforms one owned trinket, not a vendor purchase, disenchant yield, sale or arbitrage. Source establishes item IDs and use cooldown; whether the transformation retains bonus IDs/upgrade track/ilvl is NOT independently verified. No actual successful cast was recorded; not a chance study.
requirements: Out of combat; five-minute use cooldown; requires level 90 to equip.

source.title: Radiant Plume, Wowhead current item tooltip

quote: transform it into an Umbral Plume. (5 Min Cooldown)
notes: T0024; confirmed deterministic reverse on-use transformation (mastery variant back to critical-strike variant), corroborated by https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Radiant_Plume and https://wow4noobs.com/en/items/249806. Transformation does NOT prove a free trade, independent obtainable loot, disenchant eligibility or retained upgrade/bonus/item level. It is the reverse of evidence record 1101, not a separate measured processing cohort.
requirements: Out of combat; five-minute use cooldown; requires level 90 to equip.
